text_block_list.text: It was on a calm, peaceful afternoon—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer, found ya!!
Turbo did it, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Aye aye, sir!
You, hold still!
(Pop!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Finished! The wearable-style
'Tracen Academy is Great,
Come Visit Sometime' sign!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's a wearable sign for the 'Promo'
Squad!
I worked super hard stitching it together!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's the academy PR squad proposed by
Turbo.
Today is our scheduled activity day.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Now we're all reeeady!
Promo squad, full steam aheeeead!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser & Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Tra~cen~ A~ca~de~my~ is such a lovely
place~♪
You gotta come vi~sit at least once~♪♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... What kind of song is that?
I never get bored around you guys.

And so,
the 'PR' Squad's activities had suddenly
begun. It wasn't a bad thing,
so while keeping an eye on them,
I quietly went along with it, but then...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That shop's sign over there!!
It stands out way more than ours!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
So frustratiiiing!!
Trainer, go knock down that sign!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Wait a moment. Looking ahead,
it might be faster
to make our signboard stand out more.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, stand out... stand out...
Maybe... make some noise...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Sound!!!!
Leave it to Turbo!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I brought them!!

text_block_list.name: The band that was pe...
text_block_list.text:
'Sup! It's a promotional performance,
right?
Sounds like fun, so I'm down to help out~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Umm... hello?
Wait, is this really okay?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Making noise requires permission,
so that's a no-go.
However, in this case...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Turbo-san. Where did you
bring these people from?

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
—Now then,
the Street Live Fest is in full swing!
Are you all having a great time?!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
And what do you know! An Umamusume band
from Tracen Academy is joining us as a
surprise act!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright! We're Turbo's
'P-R' Squad Band!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Vocals: Turbo! Vocals: Nature!
Vocals: Ikuno! Vocals: Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All the other instruments,
total strangers!
Signboard, Trainer! The song is—

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser & Turbo
text_block_list.text:
'Tracen Academy—A Nice Place,
Come Visit Once'!!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser & Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Tra~cen~ A~ca~de~my~ is such a lovely
place~♪
You gotta come vi~sit at least once~♪♪

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Wahaha! Keep it up,
Tracen Academyyyyy!!!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What the heck is this?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately,
there was an event where we could use the
stage, which was a huge help.
Now we can promote things efficiently.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you adapting way too fast!?
Wait, Trainer, say something—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: She's actually acting like the sign?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Nature, it's your turn!
Sing, sing! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait! You don't need
to drag me into this!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature! It's time for PR squad duties!
Everyone's waiting! Sing, sing-!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ghh, their stares...! Damn it,
is this my punishment for trying to stay a
bystander...?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, if it's come to this,
then to hell with it all!!

text_block_list.name: Nature & Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Tra~cen~ A~ca~de~my~ is such a lovely
place~♪
You gotta come vi~sit at least once~♪♪

And so, the 'PR' Squad's stage was a
smashing success.
They had brilliantly managed
to convey just how fun the Academy was...
or had they?
